categories.main_business_segments: The company provides comprehensive e-commerce services for global renowned brands, covering e-commerce agency operations, e-commerce live streaming services, brand incubation and management, brand digital marketing, technology solutions, and consumer operations services. The company serves brands across apparel, footwear, luggage, accessories, sports and outdoor, health food, beauty and personal care, and other categories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary software systems including Data Mill CRM, Qingmu OMS (Order Management System), Qingmu Woodpecker (intelligent advertising system), and various AI-powered tools. Core technologies include data analytics platforms, AI-driven image processing, intelligent product tagging, multi-channel data integration, and consumer data management systems. The company leverages large language models and AI agents for operational automation and business intelligence.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global renowned brands including Skechers, ECCO, Lacoste, Emporio Armani, Farfetch,泡泡玛特 (Pop Mart), Jellycat, Under Armour, and others. Primary customer types are brand owners and distributors. Key end markets include apparel and footwear, sports and outdoor, health and wellness, beauty and personal care, and collectibles. The company primarily operates in the Chinese market with some international presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Guangzhou. It has established operations in Shanghai, Hangzhou, and other major cities. The company also has international subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, Germany, and the United Kingdom to support cross-border e-commerce and brand management operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at the midstream to downstream positions in the supply chain. It acts as an intermediary between brand owners and e-commerce platforms, providing agency services, distribution, and direct-to-consumer retail operations. The company also manages warehousing and logistics operations through its own facilities and third-party partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is to become a 'data and technology-driven retail service expert.' Key R&D initiatives include: AI technology integration across systems, intelligent product management platforms, consumer data analytics and CRM capabilities, omnichannel order management systems, and live streaming optimization. The company is investing heavily in AI applications for image processing, content generation, and business automation.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple streams: (1) Service fees from e-commerce agency operations (fixed and variable fees based on sales performance); (2) Product sales from brand incubation and distribution businesses (wholesale and retail); (3) Service fees from brand digital marketing and consumer operations services; (4) Technology solution fees from software systems and consulting services. Revenue is recognized upon service delivery or product transfer of control to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other e-commerce service providers and agency operators in China. The company positions itself as a premium service provider with comprehensive capabilities across multiple e-commerce platforms (Tmall, JD.com, Douyin, etc.). Its competitive advantages include established relationships with global brands, proprietary technology platforms, experienced management team, and full-service capabilities spanning operations, marketing, and technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized e-commerce services provider with 2024 revenue of RMB 1.153 billion, representing 19.2% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to parent company was RMB 90.54 million in 2024, up 73.84% from 2023. The company has demonstrated consistent growth with expanding profitability. Total assets reached RMB 1.729 billion at year-end 2024, with strong cash generation from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Comprehensive integrated services covering the entire e-commerce value chain; (2) Proprietary AI-powered technology platforms that enhance operational efficiency and decision-making; (3) Deep expertise in brand management and consumer operations; (4) Established relationships with premium global brands; (5) Multi-platform expertise across traditional e-commerce and emerging live streaming channels; (6) Data-driven approach to consumer insights and marketing optimization; (7) Full-service capabilities reducing client complexity and improving ROI.
